text: The Senior Vice President, Development, CreateTO; the Director, Affordable Housing Office, City of Toronto; the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO; and the Lead, Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management, CreateTO will deliver a presentation on the Affordable Housing Plan. The presentation will include a list of sites being evaluated for more aggressive affordable housing opportunities, including an assessment of financial impacts, key issues/opportunities, expected outcomes, resourcing, and overall workplan.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO received the presentation for information.
